hooks.description: Push to the default branch, unless the remote has no branch yet, force push without lease or onto the default branch, git push --all or --mirror, bypassed hooks or signing, deletion of the default branch, git commit, rebase or cherry-pick under GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null without GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL. Adds context before a push whose commits carry a committer or Signed-off-by identity other than the author. On macOS also git fetch, pull or push that does not stand alone in its call.

Commands that print a secret, a commit whose staged diff holds a credential pattern or a file that never belongs in git, and a Read, Edit, Write, MultiEdit or NotebookEdit targeting a file that holds secrets.
File content written through the shell: heredoc or redirect into a file, tee, sed -i. Inline interpreter one liners that span lines.
Commit subject that is not a Conventional Commit, or a commit message carrying an attribution trailer, a generated-by marker or a Claude or Anthropic link outside the documentation hosts.

gh pr create, gh pr edit, gh pr comment, gh pr review, gh issue create, gh issue edit, gh issue comment or gh api body field whose text carries an attribution trailer, a generated-by marker or a Claude or Anthropic link outside the documentation hosts. A --body-file read from stdin falls back to scanning the raw command text.
terraform in a repository that is not marked as Terraform based in .agent-skills.json.

Repository, organisation, label, ruleset or secret changes through gh or the API, a pull request write through the API or a GraphQL mutation, gh release where the repository's release tool (release-me or release-please) is configured, and gh repo rename, set-default, alias or extension.
gh issue edit or gh pr edit that adds an ai: label without removing another: reminds that exactly one ai: state label must remain.
Records the session for the checkout and warns when another live session already works in it.
Removes the session record at session end.
Warns once when the installed skills are behind the checkout they were installed from, or when that checkout is on its default branch and behind origin as last fetched.
Names the skills that cover the request.
A YAML, JSON or TOML file that no longer parses after a write.
Reports when a written .tf or .tfvars file is not formatted.
